full_description:
Allient Dothan/Allied Motion Technologies is in growth mode and currently seeking a 
CNC Senior Programmer/Machinist to join our team in Alabama! This position serves as the Subject Matter Expert/trainer/mentor/leader in support of the programming, operation and maintenance of all equipment within the Machine Center of Excellence.

Responsibilities:

Develop, optimize, and maintain CNC programs for multi-axis milling, turning, and mill-turn machines using CAD/CAM software (e.g., Mastercam, Siemens NX, Esprit or Fusion 360).
Interpret complex engineering drawings, blueprints, and technical specifications to ensure accurate machining processes.
Collaborate with engineering, production, and quality teams to improve manufacturability and reduce cycle times.
Select appropriate cutting tools, speeds, and feeds to maximize efficiency and tool life.
Conduct first article inspections and troubleshoot machining issues to ensure part conformance and quality standards.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives in CNC programming, setup, and machining processes.
Train and mentor junior programmers, engineers, operators, and machinists on best practices and new technologies.
Lead workshops and one-on-one sessions on:
CNC programming techniques
Workholding and tooling strategies
SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Dies)
Lean manufacturing principles
Setup reduction and process standardization
Maintain and update CNC program libraries and documentation in accordance with company standards.
Support new product introductions (NPI) by developing prototype programs and refining processes.
Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements in all machining operations.
Prepare geometric layout using computer-assisted drafting software to show location of reference points and direction of cutting paths
Determine reference points and direction of machine cutting paths
Analyze drawings, sketches, and design data of parts to determine dimension and configuration of cut, selection of cutting tools, and machine speeds and feed rates
Prepare the CNC machine for production adjusts machine settings to the desired product specifications
Complete quality control tests during the manufacturing stage and on the final product.
Design and implement efficient workholding and tooling solutions for multi-axis machining.
Collaborate with design and quality teams to ensure manufacturability and compliance with aerospace standards (AS9100, NADCAP, etc.).
Champion Lean initiatives across the shop floor, focusing on waste reduction, cycle time improvement, and setup efficiency.
Lead Kaizen events and support implementation of 5S, visual management, and standard work.
Analyze machining processes to identify opportunities for cost savings and quality improvements.

Minimum Qualifications:
· Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent experience).
· 8+ years of CNC programming experience with at least 3 years in aerospace or precision manufacturing.
Deep knowledge of G-code, multi-axis machining (3-,4-, and 5-axis), blueprint reading, tight-tolerance aerospace components, and high-performance tooling.
Proven track record of coaching and mentoring technical teams.
Strong understanding of Lean, SMED, and continuous improvement methodologies.
Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills and ability to lead root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Familiarity with ERP/MES systems and digital manufacturing tools.
Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies.
Experience with aerospace quality standards (e.g., AS9100, NADCAP)
Proficiency in CAD/CAM software such as Esprit, Mastercam, Siemens NX, CATIA, or Fusion 360.
Demonstrated experience with low-volume, high-mix production.
Familiarity with aerospace materials and machining best practices for titanium, Inconel, and aluminum alloys.

A customer may select products from multiple salesmen in the store.

full_description:
We are seeking an experienced GIS, surveying, LiDAR, and point cloud processing professional to transform a cleaned point cloud dataset and GPS/RTK survey information into a fully georeferenced topographic model suitable for engineering design, construction planning, earthworks analysis, and quantity estimation.

The selected specialist will receive cleaned point cloud files (LAS, LAZ, E57, RCP, RCS, or similar formats), GPS/RTK control data, and coordinate system information. All outputs must be accurately referenced to the provided WGS 84 coordinate framework while preserving spatial integrity and survey-grade accuracy.

Scope of Services

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

Georeferencing the point cloud using supplied GPS/RTK control points.
Validating registration quality and coordinate accuracy.
Verifying alignment consistency throughout the dataset.
Extracting the bare-earth surface and generating a Digital Terrain Model (DTM/TIN).
Producing contour lines and terrain breaklines.
Extracting spot elevation points with complete X, Y, and Z coordinates.
Classifying and digitizing visible site features.
Preparing professional GIS and CAD deliverables ready for engineering applications.
Feature Extraction Requirements

Where visible within the dataset, the following features should be identified, classified, and represented:

Buildings and associated structures
Boundary and retaining walls
Fencing
Roads, driveways, and access routes
Pavements, sidewalks, and curbs
Trees and vegetation
Utility poles and related infrastructure
Manholes and inspection chambers
Drainage systems and channels
Terrain breaklines
Stairs, ramps, and access structures
Embankments and grade transitions
Any additional site features identifiable within the survey area
2D and 3D Data Requirements

All extracted elements must be delivered in both:

2D planimetric format
3D format incorporating elevation attributes where applicable

The final GIS dataset must contain accurate three-dimensional geometry with associated coordinate information.

Required Deliverables

The completed project should include:

A consolidated DWG file fully compatible with AutoCAD Civil 3D
GIS deliverables in SHP and/or GeoPackage format
A 3D point dataset containing X, Y, and Z coordinates
Digital Terrain Model (DTM/TIN)
Contour mapping
Spot elevation points
Layer-organized CAD drawings with clear feature categorization
Both 2D and 3D representations of all mapped features
Quality Standards

Deliverables will be assessed based on:

Accuracy relative to supplied GPS control data
Correct implementation of the WGS 84 coordinate system
Consistency and quality of generated contours
Elimination of spikes, gaps, and terrain irregularities
Accurate feature extraction and classification
Logical layer organization and full Civil 3D compatibility
Preferred Software Experience

Applicants should specify their proficiency with one or more of the following platforms:

Leica Cyclone
CloudCompare
Trimble Business Center
Autodesk ReCap
Autodesk Civil 3D
ArcGIS
QGIS

Equivalent professional surveying, GIS, and point cloud processing software will also be considered.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should include:

Examples of comparable projects completed previously
A brief description of the proposed workflow and software tools
Estimated project duration
Fixed-price quotation
Project Goal

The objective is to obtain a survey-grade GIS and CAD dataset comparable to a detailed topographic survey, providing reliable information for engineering design, earthworks computation, construction planning, and quantity take-off applications.

full_description:
# Build Multi-Platform AI Sales Agent for WooCommerce (n8n + AI + RAG)

## Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced n8n developer to build a production-ready AI Sales Agent for my WooCommerce ecommerce business.

The AI should handle customer conversations across multiple channels, search real WooCommerce products, answer company FAQs using a knowledge base, log leads, and hand off conversations to human staff when needed.

This is not a simple chatbot project. I need a practical AI sales automation system connected to WooCommerce and a RAG knowledge base.

## Channels

The system should support:

* Facebook Messenger
* Viber
* Telegram
* TikTok
* Website Chat

Messages from all channels should be processed through one centralized AI workflow and replied back on the original platform.

---

## Core Features

### 1. AI Sales Assistant

The AI should understand customer intent such as:

* Product search
* Price inquiry
* Stock inquiry
* Product recommendation
* Product comparison
* Delivery questions
* Payment questions
* Warranty / return policy
* Technical service inquiries
* Order status inquiries
* Human staff requests

The AI must not invent product information. If data is unavailable, it should escalate to staff.

---

### 2. WooCommerce Integration

The AI must search real WooCommerce product data.

Required fields:

* Product Name
* SKU
* Variation SKU
* Product Type
* Price
* Sale Price
* Stock Status
* Stock Quantity
* Product Image
* Product URL
* Category
* Product Attributes

Important:

My store contains many variable products.

The system must support variation-level search, including SKU, stock, price, and attributes.

---

### 3. Product Recommendations

Example:

Customer: "I need an Arduino board for beginners."

The AI should:

* Search products
* Recommend suitable items
* Show price
* Show stock
* Provide product links
* Explain why the product is suitable

---

### 4. RAG Knowledge Base

The AI should answer company questions using a knowledge base.

Examples:

* Delivery policy
* Payment methods
* Warranty policy
* Return policy
* Reseller policy
* Technical services
* FAQ

Preferred solutions:

* Google Drive
* Supabase
* PostgreSQL + pgvector
* Qdrant

The knowledge base should be easy for non-technical staff to update.

---

### 5. CRM / Lead Logging

Store customer information such as:

* Name
* Phone
* Platform
* Conversation
* Interested Product
* Lead Status
* Conversation Summary
* Date & Time

Preferred:

* Airtable
* Google Sheets
* Supabase

---

### 6. Human Handoff

The AI must notify staff when:

* Product information is unavailable
* Customer requests discounts
* Customer complaints occur
* Customer sends payment proof
* Technical questions are too complex
* AI confidence is low

Preferred notification methods:

* Telegram
* Airtable
* Google Sheets

---

### 7. Language Support

The system must support:

* English
* Burmese (Myanmar)
* Mixed Burmese + English messages

---

## Tech Stack

Required:

* n8n
* DeepSeek or OpenAI API
* WooCommerce API
* WordPress
* Facebook API
* Viber API
* Telegram API
* TikTok API

Preferred:

* Supabase
* PostgreSQL
* pgvector
* Qdrant
* Airtable
* Google Sheets

---

## Deliverables

* Complete n8n workflows
* Setup documentation
* API configuration guide
* WooCommerce integration
* Variable product support
* Knowledge base setup
* CRM integration
* Human handoff workflow
* Testing results
* Training video
* Maintenance instructions

---

## Important Requirements

The AI must:

* Never invent stock
* Never invent prices
* Never invent company policies
* Use WooCommerce as the source of truth
* Use the knowledge base for company information
* Escalate to human staff when uncertain

---

## Questions for Applicants

Please answer:

1. Have you built n8n AI agent systems before?
2. Have you integrated WooCommerce APIs?
3. Can you support WooCommerce variable products?
4. Which RAG solution do you recommend?
5. How will you prevent AI hallucinations?
6. How will you connect Facebook, Viber, Telegram and TikTok?
7. Can you provide documentation and training?
8. What risks do you see in this project?
9. What timeline do you recommend?

---

## Milestones

1. Architecture & System Design
2. WooCommerce Product Search
3. AI Agent + RAG Knowledge Base
4. Channel Integrations
5. CRM + Human Handoff
6. Testing, Documentation & Training

## Goal

Build a reliable AI Sales Agent that can answer customers, recommend products, reduce manual work, improve response speed, and support future ecommerce automation.
